test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 7 Oct 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: The Ram Navami festival in India is celebrated as a Hindu festival on the _________ which marks the birth of Lord Ram.

options.text: ninth day of Sawan month of Vikram Sambat Calendar
ninth day of Phalguna month of Vikram Sambat Calendar

solution:
The correct answer is __**the ninth day of Chaitra Navratri.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• Ram Navami is celebrated on the **ninth day of Chaitra Navratri**, which falls in the month of Chaitra as per the Hindu lunar calendar.
 
• This festival marks the birth of **Lord Ram**, the seventh incarnation of Lord Vishnu.
 
• The day is observed with devotion and religious fervor, with devotees fasting and visiting temples.
 
• Ram Navami also signifies the end of the nine-day-long Chaitra Navratri celebrations.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Chaitra Navratri**

 
 
• Chaitra Navratri is a nine-day festival dedicated to the nine forms of Goddess Durga.
 
• It is celebrated in the month of Chaitra, which is the first month of the Hindu lunar calendar.
 
• Each day of Navratri is dedicated to a different form of the goddess, and devotees perform rituals and prayers to honor her.
 
 
 
• **Lord Ram**
 
 
• Lord Ram is considered the seventh avatar of the Hindu god Vishnu.
 
• He is the central figure in the epic Ramayana, which narrates his life, his ideals, and his journey.
 
• Ram is revered for his adherence to dharma (righteousness) and his role as an ideal king, husband, and son.
 
 
 
• **Significance of Ram Navami**
 
 
• Ram Navami is not just a religious festival but also a cultural celebration that promotes the values of righteousness, bravery, and devotion.
 
• It is celebrated with various cultural programs, recitations of the Ramayana, and enactments of episodes from Ram's life.
 
 
 
• **Fasting and Rituals**
 
 
• Devotees observe fasting, perform pujas, and chant mantras dedicated to Lord Ram.
 
• Special prayers and bhajans are held in temples, and processions are carried out with the idol of Lord Ram.
 
• The festival is an occasion for family gatherings and communal harmony, with people sharing sweets and festive meals.
